mapper.sql: t.id, t.badge_name, t.badge_type, t.badge_text, t.badge_icon, t.priority, t.target_id, t.reach_count, t.points, t.coupon_ids, t.status, t.description, t.create_by, t.update_by, t.create_time, t.update_time

FROM shop_activity_badge t LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = t.target_id AND t.badge_type = 1 AND st.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_activity a ON a.id = t.target_id AND t.badge_type = 2 AND a.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT , COALESCE(st.store_name, a.activity_name) AS targetName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_activity_badge_user bu WHERE bu.badge_id = t.id AND bu.is_deleted = 0) AS issuedUserCount
WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.is_deleted = 0

SELECT , s.user_id AS hitUserId FROM shop_activity_signin s JOIN shop_activity_badge t ON t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.badge_type = 3 AND t.reach_count > 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_activity_badge_user bu WHERE bu.badge_id = t.id AND bu.user_id = s.user_id AND bu.is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY t.id, t.reach_count, s.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= t.reach_count ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.id ASC, s.user_id ASC

SELECT , x.user_id AS hitUserId FROM ( SELECT i.user_id AS user_id, i.store_id AS store_id, SUM(i.quantity) AS pieces FROM shop_order_item i JOIN sys_order o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2) WHERE i.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.user_id, i.store_id ) x JOIN shop_activity_badge t ON t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.reach_count > 0 AND ((t.badge_type = 1 AND t.target_id = x.store_id) OR t.badge_type = 4) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shop_activity_badge_user bu WHERE bu.badge_id = t.id AND bu.user_id = x.user_id AND bu.is_deleted = 0) GROUP BY t.id, t.reach_count, x.user_id HAVING SUM(x.pieces) >= t.reach_count ORDER BY t.priority DESC, t.id ASC, x.user_id ASC
